build_xfund_dataset_builder: build an XFUNDDatasetBuilder instance to process multilingual form understanding datasets
retrieve_xfund_dataset: retrieve the XFUND dataset by downloading and extracting JSON annotations and images for all supported languages
populate_key_value_item: populate a DoclingDocument with key-value graph cells from XFUND annotation data
iterate_xfund_records: iterate through XFUND documents and yield DatasetRecord objects with ground truth key-value pairs
convert_xfund_bbox: convert XFUND bounding box data to Docling BoundingBox objects for cell positioning
